definition: רָוֶה adjective watered ; — masculine singular ׳ ר , of garden גַּן (in simile) Jer 31:12 ; Isa 58:11 feminine singular הָרָוָה Deut 29:18 (opposed to הַצְּמֵאָה ; apparently of herbage, in proverb, expression for everything ); perhaps also construct רְוֵה Job 10:15 = sated with afflication (for רְאֵה ), see [ רָאֶה ].
